description: Real-data cohort assignment with per-log provenance

cohort_definitions.evaluation_holdout: Labeled real logs sealed for evaluation; thread-grouped zero-leakage plus pre-existing frozen holdouts and wild-holdout thread 142590.
cohort_definitions.training_pool: Labeled real logs available for model training.
cohort_definitions.adaptation_pool: Unlabeled real logs (verified downloads without expert labels).
cohort_definitions.excluded_synthetic_basic: BASiC simulated logs excluded from real-data cohorts.
cohort_definitions.physical_confirmation_reserved: Reserved for future hardware confirmation flights (Goal 7); empty at manifest creation.

reconciliation.question: 114 usable source logs vs 111 unique training logs
reconciliation.finding: The figures measured different corpora. docs/DATA_PROVENANCE.md claims 111 unique training logs but its own 41-row table sums to 109; docs/PRODUCTION_READINESS.md '114 usable' equals the v2_111 candidate corpus which mixed 70 BASiC simulated logs with 44 real logs. Hash-resolved unique real-world labeled logs on disk: %d. Later candidate v3_grouped used 109 source logs; v3_unambiguous 107 after skipping 4 ambiguous group members.

split_parameters.grouping_key: normalized source thread id (discuss /t/<slug>/<id> or github issue id)

holdout_size_decision.justification_if_smaller: Corpus contains only 44 distinct real-world source incidents (thread-grouped); a >=50-incident holdout is impossible without new downloads. Holdout takes 30% of eligible labeled logs grouped by source thread so no incident spans pools.
holdout_size_decision.expansion_backlog: raw_downloads/production_targets_v3 + production_missing_attachments list additional forum attachments pending download; expanding the corpus raises both pools proportionally.
